test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Do not make noise in the classroom.

options.text: Noise should not have been made by you in the classroom.
Noise better not be made by you in the classroom.
Noise cannot be made by you in the classroom.
Noise should not be made by you in the classroom.

solution:
The correct answer is** "Noise should not be made by you in the classroom."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence **“Do not make noise in the classroom” **is in the active voice.
 
• In this sentence, **“you” **is the subject, **“do not make” **is the verb, and **“noise in the classroom” **is the object.
 
• When we convert an active sentence into a passive one, the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
• The verb is changed to a form of **“be” **followed by the past participle of the main verb.
 
• In the case of the sentence **“Noise should not be made by you in the classroom”, “Noise” **is the subject, **“should not be made” **is the verb, and **“by you in the classroom” **is the object.
 
• This is the simple present passive form. It implies that the action of making noise in the classroom should not happen.
 
• So, the correct answer is Option 4: “Noise should not be made by you in the classroom.” This is the passive form of the sentence “Do not make noise in the classroom”. It correctly conveys the same meaning as the original sentence in the passive voice.
